Question: What are the login methods available on the Vendors@Gov portal, and who is each applicable to?
Answer:
- Login methods available on the Vendors@Gov portal:
  - For Corppass Admin: use “For Business Users” option (steps 4 and 5 not applicable when already Admin). Applicable to Corppass Admin.
  - For Corppass User: use the corresponding option after email notification to activate Corppass. Applicable to Corppass User.
  - For foreign ID users: use Singpass Foreign user Account (SFA) joined with Corppass User account. Applicable to foreign ID users with an SFA.
  - For NRIC or FIN users: you should already have an active Singpass account; you may proceed to log in to Vendors@Gov using the “For Business Users” option. Applicable to NRIC or FIN users.
  - For foreign ID users (SFA): as above, SFA would have been automatically created alongside your Corppass User account. Applicable to foreign ID users with SFA.

Citations:
- [LoginRegister.pdf, Page 11]

Question: What are the rules around Corppass Admin accounts, and what happens if a user is neither a Registered Officer nor an appointed Admin?
Answer:
- Corppass Admin accounts
  - Each entity may have a maximum of two Corppass Admins. This is stated in the Step 1 note: “Note: Each entity can have a maximum of two Corppass Admins.” [Corppass Registration Guide for UEN Registered Entity, Page 7]

- If a user is neither the Registered Officer (RO) nor appointed as a Corppass Admin
  - If you are not the RO of your entity, you can submit a registration to be a Corppass Admin on Corppass Admin or approve another user to be the Corppass Admin. Examples of RO include the Owner, Partner, Director or Corporate Secretary of the entity. This is described in the Step 1 content: “If you are not the RO of your entity, you can submit a registration to be a Corppass Admin on Corppass Admin and assign the Vendors@Gov e-service to your Corppass User account.” [Corppass Registration Guide for UEN Registered Entity, Page 7]
  - The guide also notes that if you are the RO you can appoint yourself as a Corppass Admin or approve another user to be the Corppass Admin. [Corppass Registration Guide for UEN Registered Entity, Page 7]

In short: up to two Corppass Admins per entity; if you are not the RO, you can still become/assign a Corppass Admin, and ROs can appoint or approve Admins. [Corppass Registration Guide for UEN Registered Entity, Page 7]

Question: How should a UEN-registered vendor handle the Vendor ID field when setting up the Vendors@Gov e-service on Corppass?
Answer: - The Vendor ID field should be left blank when setting up the Vendors@Gov e-service for a UEN-registered entity. This is stated in the note on Step 2 (Setting up the Vendors@Gov e-service) for UEN-registered entities: “If your entity has only 1 Vendor ID, and the Vendor ID is UEN, please leave the Vendor ID field blank.” [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 9]

Question: What is the login process for a foreign individual without Singpass, and what security measures are required?
Answer:
- For Foreign Company/ Organisation without UEN (foreign vendors): Use the login method described for “2. Login for Foreign Company/ Organisation without UEN.” The guide states this login method is applicable to non-UEN registered vendors who are transacting as a Foreign Company/ Organisation. Visual aid shows “Login with Singpass” but the note explains this is for organisations registering to access Vendors@Gov.

- Security measures required:
  - Step 1: Select “For Business Users” option to login to Vendors@Gov.
  - Step 2: Enter your login details (User ID and Password) and the CAPTCHA code, then click “Login.”
  - Note: If you are a foreign individual not eligible for Singpass, you should fill in the AGD password application form and submit it through the AGD Helpdesk (as described in the corresponding notes). [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 12 and Page 28]

Question: How does a foreign individual set up 2FA for the AGD Password login, and how can it be reset on a new device?
Answer:
- How a foreign individual sets up 2FA for the AGD Password login:
  - Step 1: Download the Google Authenticator App on your mobile device from the App Store or Play Store. [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 30]
  - Step 2: Click to Log in via AGD Password (login path for individuals). This takes you to the login screen where you enter your User ID and Password, then proceed to authenticate using Google Authenticator. [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 30]
  - Step 3 (implied by sequence in other page): Enter the OTP shown in the Google Authenticator app on your mobile device and click “Validate.” This validates the 2FA setup. [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 33]

- How to reset 2FA on a new device:
  - After installing Google Authenticator on the new device, you would initiate the 2FA setup flow again by selecting the option to log in and proceed with the 2FA setup steps as described (download app, log in, then use the OTP from the authenticator app to validate). The page also notes a note/link for more information about setting up Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) using Google Authenticator, which can be used for guidance on reset/setup on a new device. [Document: LoginRegister.pdf, Page 31]

Citations:
- [LoginRegister.pdf, Page 30] for Step 1 and Step 2 of the setup flow.
- [LoginRegister.pdf, Page 33] for entering the OTP and validation.
- [LoginRegister.pdf, Page 31] for additional guidance note/link about 2FA setup.

Question: What additional steps are required for a Non-UEN registered foreign entity compared to a UEN-registered entity when setting up Corppass access to Vendors@Gov?
Answer:
- The non-UEN registered foreign entity requires additional steps beyond those for a UEN-registered entity when setting up Corppass access to Vendors@Gov. Specifically, for non-UEN entities, you must:
  - Step 1: Nominate a Corppass Admin who will register for Corppass on behalf of the entity.
    - The appointed person’s Corppass Administrator account will be registered together with the entity’s Corppass account.
  - Step 2: Activate Singpass account for the Corppass Admin (only for foreign ID users).
    - If the admin has Singpass, proceed to login to Corppass via Singpass to set up the Vendors@Gov e-service.
    - If the admin does not have Singpass, a Singpass Foreign user Account (SFA) will be created for the admin.
  - Step 3: Set up the Vendors@Gov e-service for the entity.
    - The Corppass Admin will need to complete setup of the e-service for the entity on Corppass.

Cited sources: [Corppass Registration Guide for Non-UEN Registered Entity, Page 12], [Corppass Registration Guide for Non-UEN Registered Entity, Page 16], [Corppass Registration Guide for Non-UEN Registered Entity, Page 18]
